stem: What is the most likely reason Adams opened his own hospital?

options.label: F
options.text: He wanted to work in a hospital that had an unusual name.

options.label: G
options.text: He needed a place where he could treat patients while writing a book.

options.label: H
options.text: He wanted to provide medical care to patients in the way he believed was best.

options.label: J
options.text: He needed a place where he could teach medical workers how to make patients laugh.
